rationale: The stock is sitting essentially at its intraday low (0% position in range) after a massive gap down and continued selling, with only 17 minutes to close — any position would be liquidated at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a wide-spread, volatile name. The daily loss budget is already partially consumed ($204 realized loss), and the risk/reward of entering a momentum short this close to the low with forced market-close liquidation, or a mean-reversion long against a strong downtrend in a risk-off session (SPY -1.21%, VIXY +8.96%), does not justify the exposure.
